newsitem.title: LEBANON: LEBANON'S BANKING ACTIVITY UP IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: LEBANON'S BANKING ACTIVITY UP IN APRIL.

text.p: The consolidated balance sheet of Lebanon's commercial banks rose in dollar terms to $25,210 million at the end of April from $24,737 million a month earlier, the Lebanese Banks Association said on Tuesday.

Total deposits in foreign currencies and Lebanese pounds rose to 32,784 billion Lebanese pounds ($21,240 million) at the end of April from 32,191 billion pounds at the end of March, the association said in its latest monthly bulletin.
Lebanese pound deposits climbed in the same period by 108 billion pounds to 14,851 billion pounds.
Deposits in foreign currencies also rose by $331 million to $11,619 million.
Loans and credits to the private and public sector rose by 485 billion Lebanese pounds to 26,402 billion pounds from 25,917 billion pounds at the end of March.

Loans and credits to the private sector rose by 209 billion pounds to 13,661 billion Lebanese pounds from 13,290 billion pounds while loans and credits to the public sector rose by 277 billion pounds to 12,742 billion a month earlier.
